Those projects get an HTML `page` artifact built on the project's own CSS, not a live component stage. The design was never meant to cover them with a plugin.

How it was settled: I first decided an Angular fallback myself, and you rebuked me ("Why did you decide the fallback on your own when I just asked for explanation?"). I re-asked through AskUserQuestion. Your first reply was "What cawco plugin now?", and then you chose: "Just use ur own canvas with some html or json or whatever? Cmon".

The PRD (D29, §5.10) and the spec in `.design-foundations/plans/2026-10-16-live-components.md` record this.

My memory doesn't say whether plain webpack and custom servers are handled any differently from Angular CLI. The notes name Angular CLI and plain webpack as the non-pluggable cases.
